description: Fetches a product's public homepage and runs First Sale Scout's automated readiness check: is the page readable without JavaScript (so AI assistants and crawlers can see it), is there a clear next step, findable pricing, a headline, contact and legal links, a phone-ready layout and a share preview. Returns each failed check with what was seen, why it matters, the fix and how to verify it. Use when a founder asks why visitors are not signing up or buying, or before a launch.

url.description: The product's public homepage, e.g. https://example.com

name: check_site_readiness
title: Check a homepage for conversion blockers
